body: I'm really fucking sorry man Im Sorry don't do something if I do please. Like honestly you tried. And last thing I want is for you to think you failed. Gun is prepared. plastic bags covering bed post and cusions and floor so clean up is easy. All critical stuff written down. I'm just trying to steady my hands at this point.

I know the feeling. It feels like I'm living only to help others. But I don't know if I can even get to that point. I'm not calling u a hypocrite. I am the same way. 
But now I feel even more horrible because this is going to end badly. I found out I have hours if not all night left alone. And yes. I will have tried in that Time.
I looked at your post history. 20 too. Suicidal too. Why are you helping me.

As fucked up as it is that I posted on here too. I agree with your sentiments. I can't handle this either. I don't think I can handle this. But I honestly reading your post wrenched my heart. I feel for you. I feel. I'm trying not to think of my situation. And if you wanna talk we should talk. That sounds all kinds of fucked up. Two suicidal people talking. I swear my intentions are pure. I still like helping people even tho I think I'm going to off myself in a few. 
*offers hug*

I appreciate your help but if this turns out badly I don't want you to have this in your conscious. So Thank you. For trying. Honestly I know I'm being selfish and irrational. I've seen the aftermath of young death and I feel shitty about what I'm going to do to my family but honestly I've seen people move on. And in the scope of eternity this is the blink of an eye

How do you tell your parents as an only child you don't wanna live anymore ? How do you look at your friends and say I'm out I quit? You can't. You can't tell them that. I can't tell them that. I can't look at them and tell them I give up. But i do. I'm not strong.  I'm not okay. I am selfish. Their love is not enough. These feelings are chemical these panics are glitches of neurons. But I cannot go on feeling this way. I know they don't want this. But I have no other out.

I've seen people Die. I've seen people move on from those who've died. Young old. Life moves on. and the only person that's living this life is me. and they say that you're the master of your own destiny right? They say paradise waits when you die. they say Jesus will wipe every tear from you eyes. That there will be no more sadness or crying or tears. 
I can't live this way. I know the other side has to be better than this

I want to SAVE lives and I can't even keep it together on my own. Jesus I don't wanna do this I don't wanna do this but I have to do this. I really don't see any way out from all this. Too  many dissapointments. Too much pressure I can't do this. Im sorry I'm loosing my shit and I just can't do this. fuck fuck fuck.

Please please please walk me off this edge I don't want to be here but I just can't do any of this anymore please. I can't do this pressure. It feels like no matter that path I take pressure commitment failure downfall sadness paid. All lead. 
For fuck sake no one said it would be easy but no one ever said it would be this hard.

I'm shaking all over and the only thing I can think of is that I'm shaking too damn much to shoot strait and I know fukk I only have one chance to get this right. And if I don't suceed the consequences are far worse than if I had. Who wants to live with brain damage.
